# Musician

[All quest chapters](index.md)

<a id="q-146520dc944f2d64"></a>

## Become a Musician

Brook played Binks' Sake for fifty years on a ghost ship, waiting for someone to hear it.

Choose Musician as one of your professions.

**Tasks**

- Choose Musician

**Rewards**

- Doriki +60, Belly +2,000, Musician XP +300

<a id="q-7a3326bd35ac4532"></a>

## Apprentice Musician

Every crew needs a song.

Reach Musician level 5.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Become a Musician](musician.md#q-146520dc944f2d64)

**Tasks**

- Reach Musician level 5

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +6,000, Musician XP +800

<a id="q-4ad8886109b8167e"></a>

## Journeyman Musician

Thriller Bark is where Brook found his crew again. Play a tune for three or more of your own crewmates.

Reach Musician level 25, Play a tune for three crewmates and land on a ruins island in Paradise.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Apprentice Musician](musician.md#q-7a3326bd35ac4532)

**Tasks**

- Reach Musician level 25
- Play a tune for three crewmates
- Land on a ruins island in Paradise

**Rewards**

- Doriki +240, Belly +25,000, Musician XP +3,000

<a id="q-637cd46d0378d48d"></a>

## Expert Musician

Brook became the Soul King on Namakura Island, singing for the Long-Arm Tribe. Reach the stage there.

Reach Musician level 50 and land on a town in Paradise.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Journeyman Musician](musician.md#q-4ad8886109b8167e)

**Tasks**

- Reach Musician level 50
- Land on a town in Paradise

**Rewards**

- Doriki +480, Belly +70,000, Musician XP +7,000, New World Crate

<a id="q-7ca794c34fde9771"></a>

## Master Musician

There is only one Soul King.

Reach Musician level 100 and earn the title.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Expert Musician](musician.md#q-637cd46d0378d48d)

**Tasks**

- Reach Musician level 100

**Rewards**

- Doriki +900, Belly +250,000, Legendary Crate
